summary: A form-associated group of fully clickable radio tiles with labels and optional descriptions.
useWhen: A small set of mutually exclusive choices benefits from descriptive cards and large click targets.
avoidWhen: The choices are brief and compact; use Radio.
More than one value may be chosen.

alternatives.when: A user may select zero or multiple independent choices.
alternatives.reason: Checkbox communicates independent selection rather than one-of-many choice.
Switch communicates an immediately applied on/off setting.

alternatives.when: The option list is long or the available space is constrained.
alternatives.reason: Select keeps a larger one-of-many choice set compact.

accessibility: Native radio inputs own keyboard selection, focus, and checked semantics; the complete tile activates its input.
Label the group with Field or an accessible name. Descriptions name each option separately.
states: Selection is shown by the radio indicator while the tile keeps its neutral border. Error retains the negative border, and keyboard focus keeps the focus-token outline. Inactive options cannot be selected.
The component owns form values, required validation, reset, and disabled-fieldset behavior.
responsiveBehavior: Horizontal tiles wrap to available space; use a vertical group when descriptions need more room.

angular: Use the generated radio value accessor with the standalone adapter.

styling.rationale: Tile anatomy and radio treatment belong to the component; the owner controls group width.

protected.reason: Use the supported group direction and state instead of replacing tile internals.
